status: EXPLORATORY follow-up on Jaaks panels opened by the registered run; not confirmatory; no verdict
question: At a fixed number of measurements per line, how should measurements be split between screening new pairs and verifying screen hits, and does feedback ranking help once verification is paid for?
budget: M = ceil(0.20 x menu) measurements per line in 4 rounds (same as the primary)

policies.screen_only: every measurement screens a new pair (the registered arms); no claim is verified
policies.verify_hits: each round first re-measures (other orientation, disjoint plates) earlier unverified screen hits, highest screen label first, then screens new pairs
policies.paired: every purchase measures both orientations of a pair (half as many pairs)

rankings.static: history_mean (pair's shrunk mean screen label in other lines)
rankings.feedback: frozen in-context posterior on screen measurements only (verification measurements are not fed back)

endpoint: verified discoveries per line = pairs measured in both orientations and synergistic in both; also hidden validated discoveries among screen hits and verification measurements spent
inference: same stratified line bootstrap as the primary (10,000, seed 20261003); unit = line (mean of SV and VS)
expectations_declared: screen_only verifies nothing by construction; verify_hits should dominate paired because it spends verification only on screen hits; feedback is expected to add nothing given the registered result
